column1: # What each repository declares itself to be. This is an OWNER DECLARATION, not an inference:
# nothing in this estate computes a repository's tier from its contents, because a page that
# decided its own tier would grant itself whatever claims it wanted to make.
# The tier gates what the README may assert. eval/claims.py reads this file; a README whose
# opening section does not carry its LINE verbatim is a finding, as is a SHIPPED page that omits
# its efficacy limit, a page citing evidence another repository owns, or a RECORD page selling an
# install.
# SHIPPED  installable, versioned, published in the marketplace. May cite replay evidence.
#          May never claim outcome efficacy: every replay is authored fixtures through the real
#          dispatcher, which proves it fires where the fixture says, not that a live session goes
#          better for having it installed.
# BENCH    the marketplace itself. States only facts it owns; links every fact another
#          repository writes, so one fact never has two writers that can drift apart.
# RECORD   a development record. Runnable from a checkout, not published as a product. Its
#          numbers are evidence about how the shipped work was built.
# REPO
